description: Live check whether domains are free to register, with prices (EUR) for 1-3 years and a cart link. Works for .al, .com.al, .net.al, .org.al, .edu.al and international extensions sold by Host.al (.com, .net, .org, .eu, .io ...). Up to 10 domains per call.

domains.description: Domain names to check (1-10), each with its extension, e.g. ["mybrand.al", "mybrand.com.al", "mybrand.com"]. "https://" and "www." are removed automatically.

items.description: A full domain name with its extension, e.g. "mybrand.al"

name: check_domain
title: Check domain availability
